integrity: Analytic proof from the marked-branching fixed-point equation; no numerical experiment or external validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Requires a hard finite upper magnitude cutoff and a fixed subcritical branching ratio \(n<1\).
Assumes independent truncated Gutenberg–Richter marks and Poisson offspring with magnitude-dependent productivity.
The asymptotic is only as \(\rho\) approaches \(m_{\max}\); no finite-distance error bound or critical \(n=1\) result is claimed.
title: A linear cutoff law for foreshock probability in finite-cutoff ETAS cascades
